title: ToT Storefront theme.json
description: Brand look for a tenant. A deep-partial override merged over the platform reference theme — set only what you want to change. Every value below maps to a CSS custom property the shared component library reads (e.g. color.primary -> --color-primary). Validated for known tokens + WCAG AA contrast at publish (text pairs error, muted warns).

^[_$].description: Doc/meta keys ($schema, _note) — ignored by the platform.

color.description: Color tokens. The core palette is expected for a complete theme; the semantic/state tokens are optional and fall back to platform-derived defaults.

primary.description: Brand anchor — primary CTAs, active nav, hero fill

accent.description: Single brand spark — badges, marks, large accent type

surface-2.description: Subtle inset fill between bg and surface

accent-ink.description: Accent tuned for small text/links on light surfaces (AA). Derived from accent if omitted.

primary-hover.description: Hover/active shade of primary. Derived if omitted.

accent-hover.description: Hover/active shade of accent. Derived if omitted.

focus-ring.description: Keyboard focus outline. Defaults to accent.

disabled.description: Disabled/loading control fill. Derived if omitted.

disabled-contrast.description: Text/icon on a disabled control. Defaults to muted.

field-border.description: Form-field outline (stronger than border). Derived if omitted.

star.description: Review/rating star fill. Defaults to accent.

cta.description: Primary call-to-action fill (buy button, hero CTA). Defaults to primary.

cta-hover.description: Hover/active shade of cta. Defaults to primary-hover.

cta-contrast.description: Text/icon on cta. Defaults to primary-contrast.

trust.description: Trust/reassurance accent (guarantees, compliance badges). Defaults to success.

hero-eyebrow.description: Home hero eyebrow text. Defaults to muted on a light hero, a translucent primary-contrast on a bold hero.

scale.description: Modular type scale ratio (e.g. 1.25 = major third)

headings.description: Fixed heading sizes. Each set level replaces the fluid display-scale size: hero sizes the home hero headline; h1/h2/h3 size every other heading of that level (page and listing titles, block titles, headings in page body copy). Unset levels keep the fluid scale. Use to match a source site's heading sizes.

sectionRhythm.description: Vertical rhythm between sections (e.g. a clamp())

tapTarget.description: Minimum interactive tap-target size (e.g. "44px"). Defaults to 44px.

logoLight.description: Path under public/** to the light-mode logo

logoDark.description: Path under public/** to the dark-mode logo

headerVariant.description: Header bar: light (default) or dark (primary-colour bar with the light logo)

heroVariant.description: Home hero treatment: bold (default — full-bleed primary background, light text), light (page background, brand colour on headline and CTA), banner (the hero image edge-to-edge, for source artwork that already carries the copy)

cssSize.description: A CSS length or math function over lengths, e.g. "28px", "1.75rem", "clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2rem)".
